messages:
Maya Chen: heads up — last-mile airlift for the EU batch just confirmed with CarrierX, ETA FRA gateway 2024-07-22 14:00 CEST. need clearance checklist and serial reconciliation before handover. :airplane:
Liam O'Neill: great — do we have AWB and manifest? also any customs HS reclass notes?
Priya Rao: AWB: CX123456789DE. manifest attached to vendor portal. HS code hold is possible — customs flagged GPU heatsink material for review. Julie (supply): vendor says HS 8471 vs 8542, they're asking for our import broker preapproval. i've asked for vendor declaration PDF, ETA tmrw.
Maya Chen: ok prioritize doc. we can't move to staging until serials match our expected pool (pool B). ops-bot, can you reserve 24 pallet spaces at FRA staging?
ops-bot: reserved 24 pallets at FRA-Depot-3 for 48h window starting 2024-07-22 16:00. ETA buffer +2h included. :white_check_mark:
Liam O'Neill: planning note — we need to split 40 units for Dedicated clusters (eu-west-1) and 60 for regional loaners. prepare 2-way AWB consolidation if customs cleared.
Priya Rao: serial ranges vendor provided: S/NO 1002000-1002079 (80 units). our inventory expects 1002005-1002084 (80 units) — offset mismatch at head/tail. need reconciliation at arrival.
Maya Chen: that's annoying. who is doing first-pass serial scan at FRA? Julie (supply)?
Julie (supply): vendor to provide pre-scan CSV. FRA depot will do receiving scan and hand over CSV and sample photos. i'll coordinate courier to capture QR scans.
Liam O'Neill: also note 2 units flagged as DOA in vendor pre-inspection report: S/NO 1002012,1002048. vendor offered partial credit or immediate RMA air-replace. cost delta ~ $4.5k per unit if expedited.
Maya Chen: we prefer air-replace to avoid capacity shortfall — but need business signoff. @Priya can you calc 48h expedited cost vs lost revenue risk for Dedicated cluster?
Priya Rao: on it. quick calc: expedited air-replace = $9k (total for both) including courier/insurance. projected lost revenue from 2 offline units over week = ~$15k. recommend air-replace. sending formal ask to finance.
ops-bot: finance approval required for >$5k contingency. submit PR.
Maya Chen: i'll open PR + tag @Julie (supply).
Julie (supply): PR created: PO-8742-EMERG, notes include AWB CX123456789DE and RMA expedite.
Liam O'Neill: operational checklist before handover (short):
- customs docs cleared (vendor declaration + broker signoff)
- manifest serials reconciled (scan vs vendor CSV)
- DOA units isolated + RMA label printed
- split AWB labels for Dedicated vs Loaners
- DEPOT to take 5 QA sample units for burn-in 4h
- snapshot of unit firmware build (we require fw 2.14.x)

Maya Chen: add: ensure KV cache warmers flagged for dedicated pool after placement to avoid cold-start latency.
Priya Rao: update on customs: broker confirms HS 8471 accepted with vendor declaration; clearance ETA +6h once docs uploaded to portal.
Maya Chen: good. timeline looks like: arrival 14:00, customs clear by ~20:00, staging scan complete 23:00, split/airlift for Dedicated early morning next day.
Julie (supply): depot asks for RMA manifest format. rma-bot can you provide template (CSV header + sample)?
rma-bot: attached RMA template (CSV): "rma_id,serial_number,problem_code,requested_action,awb_replacement". sample row: "RMA-2024-322,1002012,DOA,EXPEDITE_REPLACE,CX123456790DE"
Liam O'Neill: good. depot also requested we include insurance value per unit on AWB (declared value). use declared value = $11,500/unit.
Priya Rao: noted. freight insurance premium ~0.35% of declared value. added to PR estimate.
Maya Chen: one more ops constraint — FRA depot has tight dock slots overnight (22:00-02:00). if customs delays push past midnight we need to pivot to next-day scheduled airlift, which impacts dedicated capacity. set fallback: if staging > 02:00, trigger canary routing to eu-central backups for low-priority jobs.
Liam O'Neill: i'll add routing policy. keep Dedicated behind SLA though.
Julie (supply): vendor asked about palletization spec — they want our pallet ID prefix. use RWDX-PAL-24-<batchid>. sent to vendor.
Priya Rao: i uploaded prepayment docs and updated PR with insurance line. awaiting finance signoff.
Maya Chen: thanks all. action items recap:
- Julie: confirm vendor declaration PDF + pre-scan CSV, confirm pallet label format (in progress)
- Priya: finalize PR calc and attach insurance + expected expedite cost (in progress)
- Liam: add routing fallback policy for staging delays and prepare split AWB labels
- ops-bot: hold pallets and confirm depot scan workflow
- rma-bot: stand by to generate RMA labels when depot flags DOA on arrival

Julie (supply): i'll post inspection photos and CSV as soon as depot uploads. expect t+9h. :truck:
Maya Chen: perfect. will update dedicated team and stand by for go/no-go once PR clears. :thumbsup:
